title: FounderGate Evidence Bus Event
description: An append-only evidence-timeline event. HARD RULE: every event MUST carry a source; a sourceless event is not evidence and is rejected. This schema is the authoritative enum registry for both event types and source types.

id.description: Stable, unique id for this event within a timeline.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was recorded.

actor.description: Who/what produced the event (e.g. founder, lane id, ci, copilot, advisor).

subject.description: What the event is about (branch, PR number, SHA, lane id, route path).

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of the event.

data.description: Optional type-specific structured payload. No secrets, no PII, hashes only.

source.description: Provenance of the event. HARD RULE: no event is evidence without one of these source types AND a non-empty ref. Grades: github/local_file/command_output/screenshot/human_witness are VERIFIABLE (a third party can re-check); manual_note is ASSERTED (founder/operator word only); mock/planned are UNVERIFIED (not real evidence — labels an intended or simulated event honestly).

ref.description: Pointer to the source: a GitHub URL/api path, a repo-relative file path, the exact command run, a screenshot path, a note author, or a mock/plan marker. Must be non-empty so the claim can be traced.

detail.description: Optional extra provenance detail (e.g. exit code, line range, reviewer login).
